architectureConformance.method: Python re-implementation of 03-architecture-conformance-test.ps1 checks (pwsh not available in build sandbox); a native pwsh run against this same package is recommended before production use, and should produce an identical result since the check logic was reproduced line-for-line from the retrieved script.

functionalValidation.reason: FV-01 through FV-14 (agent/docs/governance/09-functional-validation-matrix.csv) require a real host: yt-dlp, claude CLI, rclone, systemd, and live/test vault data. None of that exists in this build sandbox. Do not treat architecture PASS as equivalent to functional PASS — they are different gates per ADR-007 and the release rule in 01-architecture-spec.md section 8.

portedFromProductionVMAudit.source: Google Drive: 02-Current-Files/vm_script_audit_20260728_044702.zip (real Oracle VM audit, ops-server2)
portedPatterns: sync-vault.ps1: Drive-is-canonical pull-before-run / push-after-run via rclone, ported from run_nate_herk_weekly.sh
run-vault.ps1: pull-before, push-after-on-success stage ordering matches the proven wrapper's [1/5]..[5/5] sequence
wikiagent.service: explicit HOME env, Group, and TimeoutStartSec=6h matched to the proven unit file
run-wikiagent.sh: explicit PATH export matched to the proven wrapper (systemd oneshot services don't inherit login PATH)
intentionalDeviations: Scheduling model: the proven VM uses one systemd timer per vault (weekly, fixed day/time). This build uses one shared hourly timer plus agent/scheduling/schedule.csv per the locked ADR-005 (CSV-driven multi-vault scheduling) -- this is the whole point of the multi-vault redesign, not an oversight.

Locking: proven wrapper uses a single global flock at ROOT/temp/*.lock (single vault, so a global lock was safe). This build uses a per-vault lock file so two different vaults can run concurrently without blocking each other.

knownGaps: PDF/DOCX text extraction in ingest-documents.ps1 is a placeholder marker, not a real extractor.
ingest-youtube.ps1 has not been run against the real Oracle VM network path (proxy/cookies specifics from the VM history were not verbatim available to this build).
run-claude-synthesis.ps1 calls the real `claude` CLI but has not been tested against the target host's Claude Code auth.
claude_budget_usd remains a soft, unenforced field, per the locked Summary 9 decision.
recommendedNextSteps: Run agent/tests/architecture-conformance-test.ps1 natively on the target host to confirm the PASS result with real pwsh.
Run the FV-01..FV-14 functional acceptance matrix against a disposable test vault before touching production.

Only after both gates pass: write the missing Summary 12 continuation brief and update 00-Project-Control/current-project-state.md to reflect this build's real status -- closing the exact protocol gap that let rev10 go unverified.
